limitations: Before window is 30 seconds in a restart storm; no strict equal-load A/B comparison.
Read-only preview changes decoder condition only in an isolated diagnostics process; production rollout is separate.
Fresh empty epochs without checkpoints remain CATCHING_UP in preview; not counted as recovered.

Observation includes a temporary read-only Hub subscriber in the primary execution-account container for the first approximately four minutes; it ended after a diagnostics field-access error, without modifying the daemon. Its memory exit accounts for part of that container's negative memory delta.
A read-only SQL baseline ran at the beginning of the window; no profiler or deployment ran inside the window.
Market-data, dashboard, and research images also advanced from 7d4f6f04 to the current runtime in this rollout; no strict equal-load single-change A/B attribution.
Scheduled risk window blocked entry throughout the ten-minute window; no new orders were submitted in the window.
Account-4 emitted two pre-adoption diagnostics at the beginning of the window; current checkpoint heads subsequently adopted the live source epoch.
Research collector emitted 247 kept-existing historical Hub payload conflict warnings; this independent research-data consistency issue is retained for further diagnosis.
Ten minutes cannot establish long-term absence of memory leaks or guarantee all future trading scenarios.
